lines.text: Yeah, two goldens in the house but they built different
Doja move silent, got that cold ambition
Working line princess, never ask permission
Head high, eyes sharp, always on her mission
Manipulate the crowd, she extorting scratches
Bathe in golden rays, never overheating
Independent energy, tho always chasing the attention
Meanwhile Bam Bam crashing through the scene
Big fluff,
big smile,
big lips energy
When a ball bounce he gone like a missile
Single, neuron, mind, only got a single focus
Mantlepiece going crazy, tongue flapping in the wind
Bring it back once, he'll do it all again
Stick that boy on repeat and the retrieving never ends
Trying so hard just to keep everyone safe
Golden-hearted giant
But he can fit ya neck in his mouth
Doja got that boss walk, lone wolf vibe
Bam Bam got that good boy, down-for-the-ride
One runs her kingdom, one living life for mama
Different type of legends but they both make us proud
Doja barking orders, Bam Bam panting out loud
One stays cool, one plays all night
From the break of dawn to the nights moonlight
That's the golden retriever life, yeah that's their life
Doja like, "I got this,
this universe-is mine"
Reading every situation like you owe her your life
Calculated movements, cold maturity
Running every field with total authority
If she wants affection then she'll let you know
Otherwise she's busy with her beauty sleep-
girls-gotta-glow
Never been a follower
That's not her role
Opossum face burned into her soul
Teeth like daggers
If you offer her a treat-
your hand she'll take it all
Bam Bam bursts in like a wrecking ball
Heard somebody say-
ready.
set.
go!
and he forgot it all
Could be rain, could be snow, could be spring, could be fall
If the ball gets touched-he's answering the call
Everybody laughing when he skids till he fall
Living every moment, giving it his all
Got enough love in him for every human and friend, except Teddy,
fuck Teddy
nobody knows why, fuck Teddy
But fuck Teddy
Two sides of a golden, same heart underneath
One brings the wisdom, one brings never ending energy
Doja bein gremlin
Bam-Bam spreadin' slobber
Perfect fluffy team, girl and boy
Different paths, same breed
Different ways to play the game
Woof
Yeah...
Doja the princess, Bam Bam the chunk
One holds it steady, one can't get enough
Two goldens, one home, they got it all
Doja and Bam Bam, living life so full
Yeah...
And I'm out-side
Go get that treat!
Play this shit on repeat!
